steps.hardClue: Restore power, sync the drop controller and call in the upgrade machine.
steps.clue: Restore power, sync the Glocke Drop Controller and call in Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Collect three items, open the hidden room and solve the constellation puzzle.
steps.clue: Collect the Chain Links, Chilly Chunks and Lantern, then solve the Burial Grounds constellations.

steps.hardClue: Follow the spirit to the top of the tower and obtain the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Follow Astrid to the lighthouse and obtain the Jotunn Star.

steps.hardClue: Use a crowbar and a large gun to recover a transmitter.
steps.clue: Use the Crowbar and Flak Gun Round to recover the Transmitter and install it in Tyr’s Head.

steps.hardClue: Decode two blinking lights and calibrate the radio equipment to obtain the controller.
steps.clue: Decode Tyr’s blinking lights and calibrate the radio tower to obtain the Wunderbarrage Controller.

steps.hardClue: Collect three radioactive cylinders and solve the machine puzzle to assemble the core.
steps.clue: Collect the three Uranium Canisters and assemble the Atomkraft Core.

steps.hardClue: Charge the core during a lockdown, then deliver it to the bridge.
steps.clue: Charge the Atomkraft Core and deliver it to Storm Bridge to obtain the Dravakar Shard.

steps.hardClue: Ignite the shard, feed enemies into the fire and survive the lockdown to obtain a stone.
steps.clue: Ignite the Dravakar Shard with the Jotunn Star, use a Disciple Injection and obtain the Sunstone.

steps.hardClue: Use the stone to reveal three runes, then ignite their matching fires in order.
steps.clue: Use the Sunstone to reveal and ignite the three rune-marked bonfires in order.

steps.hardClue: Destroy the rotating heads, dodge the patterned rock barrages and finish the boss.
steps.clue: Destroy the rotating heads, dodge the patterned rock barrages and defeat Dravakar.
